title: The Scorched Knight
text: A knight in fire-blackened armor sits by the road, the plates fused to each other, the visor welded shut. He is still alive inside it: you can hear him breathing, and smell him. He went to slay a dragon, he rasps.

options.label: Help him out of the armor.

outcomes.text: He will live. He gives you his sword.

options.label: The wisest asks about the dragon.

outcomes.text: Where it sleeps, and which side it favors.

options.label: Take his armor; he will not need it.

outcomes.text: Good steel. He curses you as you go.
